title: 2.2.3 Differences Between VR and AR
description: Comparative analysis of Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality across immersion, user control, device dependency, and environmental settings (Table 2.1).

questions.question: According to Table 2.1, how do the environmental settings of AR and VR compare?
options: AR functions in real-world settings while VR operates in virtual worlds
AR functions in total darkness while VR operates only under daylight
AR functions inside underwater chambers while VR operates in classrooms
AR functions in deep outer space while VR operates in underground mines
questions.correctAnswer: AR functions in real-world settings while VR operates in virtual worlds

questions.question: What is the degree of immersion experienced in AR compared to VR?
options: AR is partially immersive whereas VR is fully immersive
AR is fully immersive whereas VR is partially immersive
Both AR and VR provide completely non-immersive environments
Both AR and VR eliminate all visual sensory perception
questions.correctAnswer: AR is partially immersive whereas VR is fully immersive

questions.question: How does user presence control compare between Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality?
options: AR users control their real presence while VR users are system-controlled
VR users control physical weather while AR users are system-controlled
AR users are controlled by computer code while VR users control reality
Both AR and VR users experience complete paralysis of motor control
questions.correctAnswer: AR users control their real presence while VR users are system-controlled

questions.question: What are the device hardware requirements for AR compared to VR in Table 2.1?
options: AR runs on smartphones while VR requires a dedicated headset device
VR runs on smartphones while AR requires a dedicated headset device
Both AR and VR require multi-rack supercomputing mainframe towers
Both AR and VR operate on mechanical analog calculators without screens
questions.correctAnswer: AR runs on smartphones while VR requires a dedicated headset device

questions.question: Which statement accurately contrasts the reality types of AR and VR?
options: AR blends real and virtual worlds while VR works in fictional reality
VR blends real and virtual worlds while AR works in fictional reality
AR operates purely in text spreadsheets while VR displays audio waves
VR operates in historical archives while AR forecasts economic trends
questions.correctAnswer: AR blends real and virtual worlds while VR works in fictional reality

questions.question: Why is Augmented Reality considered partially immersive rather than fully immersive?
options: Because users remain conscious and observant of their physical surroundings
Because AR software shuts down after sixty seconds of continuous runtime
Because AR displays only display two-dimensional black-and-white lines
Because users cannot interact with any virtual objects shown on screens
questions.correctAnswer: Because users remain conscious and observant of their physical surroundings
